_comment: Detail checklist of the class (asset.check section coverage): the definition of done of an asset
of this class. Generated from the vanilla models of the class (265; every model of the class): an item every one of them
has (95 % for classes of 20 and more) is required ('missing' blocks asset.check --strict), an item at
least a quarter of them have is optional. 'vanilla' = how many vanilla models of the class have it.
satk.style.coverage. More detail in the same SA style is welcome; nothing here is a triangle count.

items.what: a skinned mesh on the 32-bone skeleton
items.fix: skin the mesh to the vanilla skeleton (kit.template --like a vanilla ped)

items.what: a head at the Head bone
items.fix: model the head around the Head bone

items.what: both hands at the hand bones
items.fix: model both hands around the hand bones

items.what: both feet at the foot bones
items.fix: model both feet (shoes) around the foot bones
texture every material from the ped TXD
